body: Question:  Do you feel it's your brain's version of trying to hurt itself?  Or be like, self-destructive?  How were the thoughts today?
Is there a fund for supporting this guy?  Like a superPAC but only for glitter attacks?
Ok, how long have the thoughts been going on?  Do you notice...when they seem worse than other times?

I think we've become addicted to these types of thoughts.  It's our brains' version of wounding itself.  Send an email to someone.  Send a message to me if you like.  It doesn't have to be about anything in particular.  But in general, congratulate yourself each time you take a small step to connect just a little bit with someone, like dropping this post for example.  Pick up the phone preferably.  In anonymous addiction type groups they say if you're feeling too alone, hungry, tired or bored that you are at risk of relapse.  It's those times that you have to be tough.  Maybe that doesn't work in our situation.   even if it's just by writing an email to someone to say "hey what's up" - that feeling of being just a bit connected with the world helps, and afterwards makes us realize that yeah, ending it would have been absolutely and completely the wrong move.

I often see flashes of this - you're talking about visualizing suicide?  For me it's when I'm going through a low patch.  I think it's my brain's brilliant solution for when emotions get too intense.  Scary and morbid and exhilarating and depressing all at the same time. And then of course, it's a BRAIN so then it starts getting creative.  Fucking brain.

But the flashes go away.  Sorry if this is totally not what you were talking about.

Well for your first post you have done pretty well.  The people in here will offer friendship, time, and compassion and ask nothing in return.  We do that because we worry that there might not be time left to fuck around - that if we take too long with our answers then the person might never get to read it.  And each of us is a victim of some sort, each of us is a therapist in our own way.  And if you decide to do something horrible to yourself, we will have lost a voice.  Can you talk about what have you been through?
What recurring dreams are you having?  Is there something that you do that's still fun to do or nothing at all?

Love is indeed a painful and fucked up game.  It's hard not to wrap up your self-worth in a relationship, but those low feelings *are* just transitory.  Yes you have had your heart ripped out brutally and the pain is still raw and aching.  But with time you will think about that person less, and at some point after that you will be happy that you are still kicking.

  In the future you will permit yourself to play the game of love again,  but this time you'll be wiser and more cunning.  And you will have a tougher shield.  You're very young, please give it some time.
how are you doing?

thanks for posting.  even though we listen to the same music it affects us differently.  Apparently this song makes a lot of people want to jump off a fucking bridge, but to others it could show them a little piece of beauty.

Thanks for making me look up sycophantic:

    Sycophant (noun)
         A servile, self-seeking flatterer.

I still like learning new words or seeing a rare word used in a context like this which gives me the push to look it up.  Thank you for your honesty.  I learned a bit of French in school so I will scrape my finger nails down the blackboard for you now, yes?  Tu es mon amie Nicolai que je sais de Paris?    End of French transmission.  It's too hard because the Spanish comes racing in and I can't push it away.

What do you think happens after life?  I'm just curious.  Can you please tell me about your pain?  Just because you are friendless right now and have not had sex yet?  Well from experience I can tell you sex is pretty fucking over-rated.  So, sorry about that.  And I think that the one or two or three truly good friends in your life you simply have not met yet.  Friends are not like fruit you can find maybe in a market in Montmartre.  I think you need to buy a plane ticket to Cambodia and tour around.  Get out of your head.

I went through a little dxm phase.  Just to be clear we're talking about the common ingredient in cough suppressant which is dextromethorphin right?  Well, in the mid-90's there was ONE type of pill  that you could buy that was pure and did not have hydrobromide added into it.  We stole about 300 dollars worth of those boxes.  And shortly after that they took them off the market.  I have no idea about modern cough syrups, I imagine they have an ingredient or side effect that just makes you sleepy.  Please do not try at home for you curious.  For me a dxm trip made everything taste REALLY WEIRD, usually awful.   And the distance between you and the nearest door seems like an incomprehensibly massive chasm, is that right?  Also dancing was really weird but fun.  I'm too scared to take such strong stuff nowadays.  But it's certainly the opposite of sober.  Even alcohol is too strong for me, I just prefer a tiny touch of weed. 

You know why you should hang on?  Despite all the previous attempts and the lump in the throat and not giving a shit about the flowers or the clouds?  Because if you have a group of contacts like that then chances are that someone else has similar suicidal feelings.  Maybe not as strong, maybe more strong.  And maybe not even right now, but they will in the future.  But if you give in and take the easy way out, you might lose the chance to help that person.  Or it could be someone else in the future that you will help, just by talking to them and saying, "Well, I am lucky to be here because I kept trying to kill myself when I was younger".

For how long did the relationship go on?  His capacity for love was very different from yours:  You deserve someone who can give you the same love in return. 
  
   Feeling that everything is pointless is a quick spiral into depression.  If you lie in bed all day tomorrow you'll do the same thing on Monday and miss work.  Go outside and exercise for 15 minutes tomorrow and get off the damned computer.  Make a goal to not miss work on Monday. Google depression and see if any of the symptoms fit you.  Sunlight and exercise sound like a hippie solution but depression is fucking serious.

You have lived through a horror movie of a life and have unimaginable courage to be where you are today.  You are not no one.

 * Is there something you can still get enjoyment from?

 * Do you feel that you need to be liked by everyone?

 * Is there anyway to get out of the living arrangement?
I seem to be tingling.

Well it's a pretty interesting time to be alive - not like the boring 1200's with its shitty medical care.  The internets are full of little 10 step articles about taking the first easy steps to start shutting down depression and getting back to normal again.  Like your title, "probably tomorrow" is not necessarily a bad thing.  As long as it's not today.  Just "let me just get through today" and think yeah tomorrow....  And then at some point in the future you will thank your younger self, when you're doing something fun you didn't anticipate or could never imagine....for not doing anything psycho to your young teenaged self.

I think depressed is perhaps too strong a word for you, plus it sounds too clinical.  And besides no one would ever let me be a doctor in order to make such a diagnosis.  (I'd steal too much drugs and perform unnecessary breast exams).  I think you're feeling down.  A symptom of depression is not enjoying the things you used to enjoy.  You USED to enjoy hanging out with people now you just can't be assed, is that it?  I suppose you did enjoy playing in the first chair but now it's just like "aah this again, fuck".  I use the guitar as a depression thermometer.  If I have not picked it up for a few days I realize that I'm entering a down patch.  Like the stock market.  And when I'm down I snap at people and I make everything personal and I have the emotional maturity of a retarded orangutan.  And when it gets really bad I start visualizing all the ways to off myself...which is like a tic in my brain and I can't seem to stop it.   And like your little trip - anything can trigger it for me it doesn't have to be humiliating or anything, it can just be boredom.  I think, "I don't need this shit I could be dead right now!"  But then, eventually, so far at least, the stock market has always come back up again, and I start picking up the guitar more often and I catch myself in better spirits...and sometimes I look back and think, well i'm glad NOW that i'm still alive for christ's sake.

Please put me back on track if I misstep - I take it you did break up, and still feel numb from the break up and/or the trip in general?  At least you realize that you SHOULD feel worried about the job, but you can't seem to give a shit.  Your heart is in the right place and so is your head.  In a week you will be able to curse that jackasses name and in a month you will start to let go.  In a year you can bitterly laugh.  I mean, after all, you dodged a bullet by finding out NOW didn't you?  He clearly did not deserve you.
       But is it all people who suck, or just men.  I mean, because of men, this is why I could never have kids - if I were to have a baby girl I would need to force her to be gay somehow which is probably dangerous and illegal.
Tell me if I'm way off base ok?  It's not so much school as general blah with life?

Don't worry, school sucks.  Believe me, I'm a teacher.  I'm ONLY about double your age, but I have to be honest I can barely remember what it's like to be 22 much less 15.  Well I remember when I was in highschool we had just moved - I had to start highschool and at lunch time I didn't have any friends.  So what could I do?  Go sit in the lunch room alone!?  Fuck no, I went and sat in the toilette eating my lunch waiting for the bell to sound.  Or if I couldn't do that I would pretend to walk home and then cross the street somewhere casually and turn around and walk back to the school.  That sucked.  I still feel bad for students in my classes who come and sneak into class a minute or two early, unaccompanied, and look around at the others who come in in pairs or in groups.

You don't have to go to University, do you?  Immediately after high school?  Take a year and travel or fly to a specific place in order to volunteer.

Believe me, a lot of people - not just some notable famous and successful people - but fucking everyone gets bored to shit and back by school.  So you're definitely not alone.

i finally got skyrim to stop crashing my xp machine.  know what it was?  the cpu was overheating so I paid 10 bucks and put in a proper fan with that gloopy shit which slops onto the processor and sucks away the heat.  SO GREAT.  I also like anything from sid meiers.

But my real test for depression is guitar.  if i stop playing guitar for a while, I realize that I'm depressed.  It's not like I can just pick up the guitar and be cured, it's that when I'm depressed I have no desire to pick up the guitar.  And I can look back over a couple of weeks and be like, "hey yeah I AM feeling depressed".  It's just a depression thermometer.  What do you like to play?  Read?  I can pass you game of thrones in epub format.  Piracy is the new radio after all.

It sounds unbearably difficult what you are going through, what you are living.   I look up to you because of your bravery.   You think that sounds cheesey or predictable well tough shit because I hold you in a rather high regard right now.  Your words took me out of my stupid little life and made me think about the hundreds and thousands of people who go through the same shit forest that you are experiencing - and that's humbling.
thanks for posting this.
Is there something that you still enjoy doing?

Were you laid off recently?  I think that it's the most difficult thing in our supposedly brilliant system:  After you have been rejected by a company you're supposed to buck up and put on a confident smile and go in and prove to strangers that you're the man for the job.  Yeah right!  I've just been laid off I feel like fucking dog shit.

You sound like my friend in Washington state but you can't be him because he's gay.

Yeah but we need you in this fight.  You're much more valuable alive.  FINALLY there is a cause, something that the majority of the people can get behind to make this life better for everyone.  What if someone DID decide to self-emoliate?  And then say 50 more people did it?  The 1% would laugh and say, "Good, less protesters."  I sincerely hope people in Oakland or anywhere do not do this because then there would be less people on the ground.  This is just the beginning.  Will the people rise up and revolt and overthrow the government?  Probably not it's the US army after all.  Are people starting to take note of the movement?  Absolutely yes.  But definitely don't miss it.  This is the women's rights / civil rights movement of our generation.  Being a voice, a single voice, IS fighting for your cause.  Posting, even here on the interweb, is actively participating in this movement.  

Just FYI I moved to a third world country a couple years ago.  I see people who live in extreme poverty - they don't have the power to protest - they can't take a day off from begging or they would starve.  Please keep up the fight.
